label: Develop — Pin Mapper & Conflict Detector
description: Given a list of required peripheral functions and the active HKP, produces a conflict-free pin assignment. Respects flash-reserved pins, input-only pins, strapping-pin boot constraints, ADC1-vs-ADC2 Wi-Fi rules, and DAC / touch / RTC-GPIO requirements. Surfaces every assignment with the HKP claim that supports it.

claudeKnowledge.description: ESP32 GPIO matrix, peripheral routing, pin capabilities
